name: Super Scary ARG
source:
So basically Trybien corrupted me into participating into Super Scary comp with a subversive comedy case and so we collabed. Except that happened in another timeline apparently.

Overdosed with references to [i]Umineko[/i] and [i]Zero Escape[/i], as well as both classic and newfangled AAO community, but still mostly comprised of purely random humor, these are the vestiges of a really silly ARG aimed at the Super Scary comp's hosts [GONE WRONG][GONE SUS][GUIDELINES BROKEN][DISCORD CALLED].

Honestly, there isn't that much interesting stuff in it, but it may yet be funny to go through for some. I have no regrets. But also a bunch of them at the same time. Oh well.

[From [url=https://aaonline.fr/forum/viewtopic.php?t=13398]AAOnline[/url]]
translation:
简单来说，就是Trybien把我拉下水，撺掇我合写一个颠覆套路的恶搞喜剧案件去参加“Super Scary”大赛。只不过那好像是在另一条世界线里发生的事了。

这部作品塞满了海量致敬[i]《海猫鸣泣之时》[/i]与[i]《极限脱出》[/i]的梗，还混杂了AAO社区新老世代的内部梗，但归根结底大半都是纯粹的无厘头搞笑——这就是一场专门整蛊“Super Scary”大赛主办方的沙雕ARG留下的残迹[彻底翻车][可疑拉满][版规打破][惊动Discord]。

老实说里头也没多少真正有营养的内容，不过对某些玩家而言逛一圈应该还是挺乐呵的。我一点都不后悔——但同时又后悔了一大堆。算啦，就这样吧。

[摘自[url=https://aaonline.fr/forum/viewtopic.php?t=13398]AAOnline[/url]]
